summary: Jiayao An works in history, archaeology, and Sinology. She studied under Su Bai from around 1979 to 1982 and held posts at the Institute of Archaeology, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, from around 1982.

Jiayue Kang specializes in Indology, philosophy, and linguistics. Kang completed graduate studies at East China Normal University (1996–2001) and an MA in Sanskrit at Silpakorn University (2022–2025), where Kang also held a post.

Jiegang Gu was a Sinologist and historian who studied at Peking University (~1913–1920) under Hu Shih and Taiyan Zhang. He held posts at Peking University (~1920–1926), Fudan University (~1948–1954), the Chinese Academy of Sciences (~1954–1977), and CASS (~1977–1980).
Jien Abe (1937–2001) was a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar. He studied as a graduate student at the University of Tokyo (attested 1973) and served as a professor at Meiji University until 2001.

Jifu Lan is a scholar of Buddhist studies, history, and archaeology. He studied at Tunghai University (~1965–1969) and was a full-time researcher at the Chung-Hwa Institute of Buddhist Studies from around 1985 until retiring in 2019.

Jigdal Dagchen Sakya was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who studied under traditional teachers Ngawang Thutop Wangchuk, Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, and Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche. He held a post at the University of Washington (~1960–1963).

Jigme Chhoeda is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology figure. He studied at Druk Sangag Choeling and Tango Monastery under several traditional teachers, later serving as Abbot of Tango Monastery (~1986–1996) and holding Lopen posts with the Central Monastic Body.

Jigme Pema Wangchen is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar. He studied under traditional teachers Dzi Gar Khenpo Nor Yang, Drukpa Khenpo Ngawang Chödrak, and Mi-pham-bśad-sgrub-chos-kyi-ñin-byed-mchog.
Jigme Tenpai Nyima studied under Patrul Rinpoche, Jamgön Kongtrõl Lodrö Thaye, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso. He also taught Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.
Jigmeth Junu is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned an MA at Fo Guang University (attested 2013). There, studies were conducted under MA supervisor Yongdong Shi and traditional teacher Hui Xian.
Jikai Fujiyoshi was a Buddhist studies scholar. He served as a professor at Rissho University and was a member at Kyoto University (attested 1967).

Jikido Takasaki specialized in Buddhist studies and Indology, earning degrees at the University of Tokyo and Savitribai Phule Pune University. He held posts at Tokyo, Komazawa, Osaka, and Waseda Universities, and served as President of Tsurumi Women's University.

Jim G. Shaffer is an archaeologist and Indologist. He earned a BA from Arizona State University (~1961–1965) and a PhD from the University of Wisconsin-Madison (~1966–1972), later serving as an anthropology professor at Case Western Reserve University (~1974–2014).

Jim Rheingans is a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who earned degrees from Hamburg, Bath Spa, and the University of the West of England. He has held posts at the universities of Hamburg, Vienna, and Sydney (all attested 2026).

Jin Kyoung Choi specializes in Buddhist studies and Indology. Choi studied for a doctorate and worked as a postdoctoral researcher at Ghent University (attested 2026), and served as a lecturer at the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities (attested 2026).
Jin Y. Park works in philosophy and Buddhist studies. Park served as an assistant professor at American University (attested 2007–2012) and was a visiting fellow at the City University of Hong Kong.
Jin-il Chung is an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who has held posts as a collaborator (attested 2008) and editor (attested 2026) at the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities.

Jinah Kim specializes in art history, Indology, and Buddhist studies, earning a PhD from UC Berkeley. She held posts at Vanderbilt University and the Institute for Advanced Study, and is a professor at Harvard University (attested 2026).
Jinavijaya Muni was a scholar of Indology and history and archaeology. He served as Principal of Gujarat Vidyapith and founded the Rajasthan Puratana Granthamala (attested 1959).

Jinbo Shi works in history, archaeology, linguistics, and Buddhist studies. Educated at Minzu University of China and CASS, he has held posts at CASS, Minzu University of China, North Minzu University, and Ningxia University.
